description:
README.md "Registered methods" table (lines 70-97) and the
EmailSubmissionSetParams Rust code snippet (lines 107-122) drift from real
signatures:

1. `email_submission_query_changes`: README says 3 args (since_query_state,
   max_changes, filter). Real signature in src/methods/submission.rs:117-123
   has 4 args (also sort).
2. `vacation_response_set`: README says `update: Option<Value>`. Real
   signature in src/methods/vacation.rs:54-57 is
   `update: Option<HashMap<Id, PatchObject>>`.
3. EmailSubmissionSetParams Rust snippet in README lines 107-122 shows
   `on_success_update_email: Option<serde_json::Value>`. Real struct in
   src/methods/mod.rs:113-137 has
   `on_success_update_email: Option<HashMap<String, jmap_types::PatchObject>>`.
4. AGENTS.md (lines 30-32) says this crate "Implements ... methods for ...
   MDN, plus extension methods for blob upload/download." MDN is NOT
   implemented; there is no blob-upload/download wrapper in this crate.

Impact: a new contributor or user looking at the README to learn the public
surface gets misleading information. This is the kind of doc rot that makes
the canonical-template story untrustworthy — the README is supposed to be
the contract.

Fix: regenerate the table from a single source of truth (the actual method
signatures), and either implement MDN/blob-upload helpers or remove the
claim from AGENTS.md. Recommend the latter — blob upload/download lives in
jmap-base-client and MDN is not implemented per PLAN.md scope.

Will recur unless the doc table is generated or pinned with a doc-test that
fails when signatures drift.
title: README 'Registered methods' table out of sync with code signatures
